0.content:
Danica Postelnitskaya is head housemaid of the Snezhnayan royal household and, with Vesna, one of the Tsaritsa's two right hands: Vesna executes military decrees, Danica state affairs. They met as children studying under Capitano. They once climbed onto his shoulders trying to steal his mask, Danica's idea according to Vesna, and were made to stand at attention on a frozen lake for hours. Vesna pranks her endlessly: lemon slices in her plate and tea, doodles under her teacups, unwanted vegetables slipped onto her plate (they always come back). Danica warns new maids to ignore it, because a reaction only delights the culprit. Vesna insists she is two whole months older and complains that Danica now acts like the adult. Danica says Vesna acts on a whim and criticises her driving.

Danica left Snezhnaya for eight years as a wandering mercenary after a big argument, then returned to serve. Their reunion meal, with toasts to Her Majesty, to beautiful dreams and to the future, is the memory inside Vesna's own Seal of Life. In 7.1 Danica tested the Traveler at Podvorye with Capitano's Mora game, and Vesna stopped her: "a guest is a guest." Vesna says Danica cares for the Tsaritsa flawlessly but is hopeless at conversation, so breaking the ice falls to Vesna.

When Capitano died, Vesna sparred with Danica, then lay on the training ground and directed her about like an honour guard until Danica's shadow blocked the sun from her face, as Capitano's once had. Danica's eyes stung without her quite knowing why. Vesna left her a cup of lemon water "so if you start crying, you'll have an excuse." During Swords and Secrets Danica tracked Vesna's absences, made her clean up the mess, and explained to the Traveler that each sword spirit carried one of Vesna's own wishes.

1.content:
When the Tsaritsa gave ten-year-old Vesna a Druzhna recruit's badge, the First Harbinger Capitano became her teacher; Pulcinella said it was Capitano's idea. He told her to call him "Teacher". He crouched to her eye level and removed his mask to show her that he too carried an extraordinary power that was never truly his, of the same order as her Life authority. Even without it, he said, he would be no lesser a man. The early spring had come for her, not for the power. He wanted to see her at the pinnacle of the Druzhna, and she got there.

News of his death reached her while she was sneaking lemon slices into Danica's cup. She kept adding them until the cup overflowed, then rested as if exhausted. She remembers his back as a steadfast mountain. He used to say that in a real war you don't get to say goodbye; she cannot forgive him for proving it ("I'll never let that go, Teach"). She blames the Heavenly Principles' agents for what happened to him.

After his death she dreamed of him at the edge of a many-coloured world. He told her to go back, that his journey ended there, and that they would meet again "among the myriad lives touched by the thousand winds". Danica preserves one of his sayings: the deepest wishes are not meant to be laid bare but engraved upon the heart.

2.content:
The Tsaritsa visited the Strivozha estate after Vesna's unusual birth and named the baby herself: Vesna, "the spring that walks beside her". She is the only Strivozha in five centuries named by Her Majesty. The Tsaritsa watched over her growth and sent Pulcinella to ask her "What is love?". She gave Vesna a Druzhna badge rather than a political career, and later the elegant outfit Vesna wears. Vesna serves her as the "keen blade" of the Druzhna, and attends ribbon-cuttings and banquets on her behalf while the war on the Heavenly Principles goes on. Her battle cry is "For the Tsaritsa!"

Vesna rejects the Tsaritsa's own view that a god's love is a curse. She points to the "rest well" in Her Majesty's decrees and to the returned remnant of her Life power as proof of real care. Drawing a Seal of Life from the Tsaritsa, she found no happy memories at all, only endless white snow, yet her life force persisted. After Rhinedottir restored the seals Vesna thought she glimpsed a faint light behind Her Majesty, as if she sometimes turns to look at those following her through the storm.

The Tsaritsa once refused Vesna a private train and later granted her one for an off-peak loop after much pestering. Vesna's companion talk says the Tsaritsa and Danica rarely speak to her except on official business, and that she tries to lighten the palace's silent evenings.

3.comment: Vesna: Authority of Life and the Seals of Life
3.content:
In the Hyperborean age the former Archangel stole a fragment of power from the Ruler of Life, Naberius. It passed from hand to hand and was entrusted to the first Vila, Vesna's direct ancestor. In Vesna it awakened for the first time in five hundred years. In 7.1, with Mitya bearing the mark of Death, the Tsaritsa revealed at the Armory Palace that Vesna bore the "mark of life", spoiling Vesna's dramatic build-up. Prompted by Sandrone, Vesna showed that she could draw "Seals of Life": iridescent bubbles holding a person's most cherished memories, whose life force might, gathered en masse, defy Ronova's Curse of Death. She drew them from the court, then from officials and nobles, with donation compulsory for those ranks, and from eager volunteers at the Northland Bank, until she was run off her feet.

She and the Traveler collected seals from the townsfolk of Svetloledovka. When a False Horned Steed, a creation of the Ruler of Life, began draining the seals from the bank vault, Vesna used the authority to fight back. The Tsaritsa froze the beast, but Rhinedottir arrived, let it go, reclaimed the stolen power and returned every seal to its owner. Vesna said the power had only gone back where it belonged. Pantalone later returned to her the beacon she had made from it, as the Tsaritsa had planned; Rhinedottir did not care to reclaim the last morsel so long as there was no further large-scale seal collection.

Vesna believes the Ruler of Life's original contract with her ancestors may have meant that the custodian should make a stand when the time came, and she tried even when told it was force majeure. Losing control of the power pained her. In the final battle with Ronova (Act IV) she still used the "Authority of Life" at the last moment to form a Seal of Life from the Traveler's memories, which carried them out of the afterlife.

4.content:
The Druzhna is the Tsaritsa's personal guard, mostly Vila, answering only to her. The Belyi Tsar founded and led it; the Tsaritsa later took it as her own. Vesna is its Commander-in-chief. Its duties go beyond war: protecting Her Majesty, campaigns against monsters, containing Shadow Realm breaches, law enforcement, and anything touching the Tsaritsa's "authority and honor". Vesna will not lend it out as private help, though "Vesna the Vila" is happy to help.

After 7.0 the Druzhna was severely short-handed. On the Tsaritsa's order Vesna ran a "special recruitment project" for Shadow Realm work, with officer Yarovaya testing applicants, and spotted the Traveler's registration. The 3rd Company was lent to Pulcinella to review corruption cases. Vila rebels who cling to old privileges are, to the Druzhna's Vila, traitors and a shame upon their kind.

Her boot-camp lessons: stand firm against the wind and snow; your sword arm must never tremble; do not weep before your foes. To these she adds a lesson the Traveler taught her: keep a soft touch for those you defend once the blizzard dies down. She runs early "rotary flight" training sessions.

5.content:
When Vesna was about ten, a "special tutor" arrived at the Strivozha estate on a stormy night. It was Pulcinella, Mayor of Snezhnograd and Fifth Harbinger, sent by the Tsaritsa. He called her "Miss Fern" with her mother's permission and confirmed that the Tsaritsa had never wholly trusted House Strivozha. He explained why: Gluvasha's poisoning of Grand Duke Photius and her double game in the rebellion. Three days later Vesna drove a dagger into the table and offered her blood. Flustered, he explained that the Tsaritsa's question was simply "What is love?" She answered: "Love is creation!" To her it was the power to create strength, laughter, courage and hope for those you cherish.

He left delighted, ended Pyotr's control over her education, and wished that she would help Her Majesty "create a world with much love in it". Today she admires how effortlessly he commands the Snezhnograd Veche.

6.comment: Vesna: House Strivozha and the crimson fern
6.content:
House Strivozha is an ancient Vila bloodline, older than Snezhnaya's turbulent early days. Its legendary crimson fern was cultivated by Vaselisa von Strivozha, The Pure One, who presented Emperor Monomakh with a perfume made from it; the fern came to symbolise Vila purity, benevolence, sincerity and immortality. Benigna's fall at Vesna's birth crushed it, and it stopped growing. Vesna's mother told bedtime stories built from garden flowers: "my brave little snowball flower", "my immortal little flame fern". When little Vesna concluded that nothing lasts forever, Benigna answered that her love would. Grand Duke Pyotr, Vesna's grandfather and reigning Grand Duke of the Vila, raised her as the house's hope with relentless lessons.

The fern's darker history: Gluvasha brewed its fronds into poisoned mead. Few Veche seats are reserved for the house, fewer than for the merchant class. Vesna proudly uses the family heirloom as a baton. She tells the Traveler that her forebears stood by the Tsaritsa after Tsar Monomakh's sacrifice, and asks whether she can do their legacy justice. The fern itself proved lethally poisonous when she revived it, and it yielded her Stellar Linchpin.

7.content:
When a Northland Bank employee was caught selling stolen Seals of Life and pointed at Pantalone, the Tsaritsa ruled out his involvement, but Vesna escorted the Traveler to the bank anyway. Her pretext was retrieving an item from her own vault. She found a secret emergency passage between the vaults and knocked out the clerk. With his walkie-talkie and access card she bluffed guards about broken safes and stole two high-security cards. She reached Pantalone's office, where he had been expecting them. Together they faced the False Horned Steed, with Pantalone's turrets helping. Later he handed Vesna a lantern of the Life power, saying he keeps his promises, and refused to lend her a train: her credit is not good enough, and won't be while he lives.

Her family's spare funds have been managed by the Northland Bank as long as she can remember, and the compound returns mean she never worries about money. She repeats Pantalone's boast that the bank will become the beating heart of the world's finance. At dinner afterwards she stole Danica's steak with a feint.

8.content: Vesna sent the Traveler a breezy letter promising a "prize" and summoned them to Zapolyarny Palace. There she proposed them as Her Majesty's new adviser for decrees too small for ministers and too minor for the army: someone skilled who answers to no faction. Danica objected that the Traveler serves no one. The Traveler accepted only "as a friend", and the Tsaritsa named them "Consultant", an envoy who reports through her secretary Chayka. Vesna: "We're colleagues now!" She later drove the Traveler round the off-peak loop on the train the Tsaritsa had finally approved for her, before their first court assembly. It was a near-crash, cleared by melting an ice blockage. She notes how useful it is to the Tsaritsa that officials fear a secret envoy may be watching.

9.comment: Vesna: Swords and Secrets: the runaway sword spirits
9.content:
After buying a supposed ancient Liyuean cultivation manual, the Ancient Sword Esoterica, Vesna tried to raise sword spirits. Her Life-touched power gave a batch of her flying swords too much "spiritual power" and they fled. One stole gems in the city; others brewed a sweet "elixir", stewed in an elixir cauldron, painted a "sigil" portrait of Danica on a cliff, and took over a Landcruiser as a mechanical body. She would not send the Druzhna after them, partly because the corps was stretched and partly to keep it quiet. Instead she roped in the Traveler and Paimon with a "Divine Sense Compass", in truth her own elemental sensing bending a needle. She tracked the spirits down, with Vodyanitsa and Odette's help at the theater.

The last, the Greater Sword Spirit, had taken in two Volkodlak who had turned to roadside robbery to survive and dreamed of guiding every fae to the right path: Vesna's own childhood wish. She let the bandits flee because they had barely begun their careers. When the shy Master of Sound poured its own power into the Greater Sword Spirit and began to fade, she played the villain, called it to her, then revived it, and sent the Greater Sword Spirit and its followers to study fae history at Druzhna HQ under her eye. The "manual" turned out to be an unpublished novel draft from Yae Publishing House, shelved by Mr. Nine. Her lesson: a single wish is only one facet of a soul, and what matters is mastering the many wishes within it.

10.comment: Vesna: Friends at the Korolevskiy Theater
10.content: Before duty piled up she went to every premiere, front row, after baking something sweet and taking a long bath. She loves Vodyanitsa's songs, conducts the post-show sing-alongs with her baton, and has spotted Vodyanitsa sneaking into the crowd in a hat to sing harmony. She cracked down on ticket scalpers and plans to have Vodyanitsa host a small conference on ticket-scam prevention, closing with a song. She steals glances at Odette at court, teasing about her "alter ego" ("prima ballerina, of course. What did you think I meant?"). Odette in turn calls her one of the tundra's fiercest predators. She met Alyosha at the seal drive and wondered how a mere hunter got so close to the stars and the Traveler.

11.content: Vesna has no Vision. After hearing of Capitano's death she went home and poured her Life power into the crimson fern, which had stayed frozen in the state it was crushed in for more than ten years. A bud appeared (ferns do not bud), swelled and burst into poisonous spores that knocked her out. She dreamed of her teacher, woke under the stars, and found a single green jewel in the bloom. She calls Stellar Linchpins beautifully designed collector's items, would like a Moon Wheel, and is "not interested" in Visions for now.

12.content: Mitya often sneaks out of the Armory to join her mischief, "me, Mitya, and his ever-so-clever scarf". Waiting with him at the Armory Palace, she asked whether he feared needles, comparing anticipation to their own unexplained summons. Pierro introduced the Mirror of Remembrance there and was one of the few who already knew of her power. She sees his heavy steps and masked sorrow as Capitano's. In Act IV Mitya credited "Valeriy and Miss Vesna" with the military support for the Rankova Zorya operation against Ronova.

13.content: Vesna loves trains and drives them far too fast. Danica says she accelerated round a bend and sent three people flying, earning a six-month driving ban; Vesna calls it "being one with the vehicle". The Tsaritsa refused her a private train, Pantalone keeps refusing to lend one, and she asked the Traveler to lend her theirs. Eventually Her Majesty let her run one on an off-peak loop. Once she overslept and got off at Rankova Zorya, leaving all her belongings on the train.

14.comment: Vesna: The thief she let go
14.content: Vesna once arrested a fae for theft. He cried so pitifully that she let him go, vouched for him personally and promised everyone he had changed. He went straight back to stealing, this time from the city's defence supplies, and several patrol guards nearly froze to death. She wanted to run herself through. She arrested him again, reported for punishment and cleaned up every mess. Betting everything on "one more chance", she now says, is naive at best and makes you an accomplice at worst.
